comparison.objective: Strip 8–12 mm of insulation using a lever-operated benchtop station; candidate commissions and locks a robot-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires cable pickup, depth-controlled insertion, bimanual lever holding, and withdrawal while blades remain closed. Candidate requires hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar micro-rotation, torque-limited locking, and repeated dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires an 8–12 mm strip, cable withdrawal while the lever stays within 4° of closed, lever release, and hands clear. Candidate requires two repeatable ≥0.85 J stops without exceeding 12 mm or causing impact, rebound, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual coordination and insertion are generic; material removal with synchronized lever actuation tests a different ability from tuning and retention verification.
